'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 SAN LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[SAN]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Username:''' Pancakes
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
